choices.content: At an endpoint of the major axis
At an endpoint of the minor axis

question.prompt: When an ellipse is used to describe a planet's orbit, where is the Sun usually placed?

solutions.explanation: In the usual ideal model of a planet's elliptical orbit, the Sun is placed at one focus. The sum of distances to the two foci is constant by the definition of an ellipse; the Sun's focal placement is an additional physical modeling fact. Thus the answer is D, at one focus.
solutions.title: Elliptical-orbit model
